title: Book Two · Chapter 186: The Same Blank Sheet
story:
The new term begins after the winter holiday. Ronan is nearly fourteen now. He walks to school with his application flat inside a book.

The materials trial notice is still near the gate. Two more copies are outside the reading room. A box beneath one copy holds blank applications.

Ronan puts his completed sheet on Miss Wu's desk. There are several others in a neat pile. She checks his name and the four dates.

“Your test is next Tuesday,” she says. “The paper task is first. The spoken task follows it.”

“How many people can try?”

“Everyone who applies by Friday. Three students can take the trial places.”

She gives him the test rules. The basic answers must be right. Students must explain the pages clearly and show the useful lines.

If the page does not answer a question, they must say so.

“A teacher will check your work,” she adds. “You cannot change opening times. You cannot promise things for the room.”

Ronan reads the four-week limit again. One afternoon each week. Then the trial ends, and the room checks the work.

Outside, a girl takes a blank application. Ronan remembers her from the old final shortlist. She did not get one of the two full places.

She sees his rule sheet.

“Are you trying too?” she asks.

“Yes.”

“I can manage four afternoons. I could not do more this term.”

She puts the blank sheet in her folder. Ronan makes room for her at the notice. She has time for this work too. Ronan is not the only person who wants a place.

At lunch, Leo asks about the application. Ronan tells him the test day.

“Want a sample?” Leo asks.

“A different one from the old practices?”

“I can find a public sample. Everyone can take those.”

“Yes. Thank you.”

Mei offers to ask him one question from it. Ronan agrees, but he also sets time to work alone. The new test will need his own answers.

After lessons, he goes to the sample box. There are three kinds of pages. He chooses one about a room change and leaves the other copies neatly behind.

At home, he puts the page beside the application rules. Mum asks how it looks.

“Possible,” he says. “I still need to do it.”

She gives him tea and takes her own work to the other end of the table. Ronan writes his name on the sample page, then crosses it out. No one needs that name today. He turns to the first instruction and begins to read.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

blank＝空白的；by Friday＝最迟星期五；explain＝解释；make room＝让出空间。

## 理解问题

1. 所有申请者都需要完成怎样的新测试？
2. 另一位申请者为什么也觉得四周试做适合自己？

## 读句子

**She checks his name and the four dates.**

拆开看：She / checks / his name and the four dates.

她／核对／他的名字和四个日期。
